title: feat: add Pollen spent KPI view
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds Pollen spent as a switchable Revenue KPI view
- Reuses the existing weekly usage revenue field
- Keeps Stripe revenue and ARPA in the same cycling row
- Adds focused view and value coverage

gist.headline: The KPI garden gets pollen
gist.blurb: The internal dashboard can now look at Pollen spent alongside Stripe revenue and ARPA. Same weekly usage nectar, one more useful lens.
gist.summary: Added a switchable Pollen spent view to the internal Revenue KPI cycle, using the existing weekly usage revenue field while retaining Stripe revenue and ARPA views.
gist.impact: Operators can now inspect Pollen spending directly in the KPI dashboard without changing the underlying weekly usage revenue data.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy internal analytics garden where Polli, wearing tiny analyst glasses, rotates a three-panel CRT KPI display between Stripe revenue, ARPA, and a prominently glowing Pollen spent panel; small code-plants and flowers grow around the dashboard to represent weekly usage data.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot wearing tiny analyst glasses, turning a chunky retro CRT KPI dashboard with three friendly panels labeled 'STRIPE', 'ARPA', and 'POLLEN SPENT'; the Pollen spent panel glows lime green (#ecf874) while weekly data sprouts as tiny code-plants and pastel flowers around it. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful.
